description: This file defines a class containing constants for special 'known' message subjects used in the Ditto messaging framework. It includes a single constant for the 'claim' message subject and enforces immutability.

classes.name: KnownMessageSubjects
classes.description: A utility class containing string constants representing special message subjects in Ditto that possess a predefined meaning.

methods.name: KnownMessageSubjects()
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of the utility class.
